name: dotted-glow-background
title: Dotted Glow Background
description: Covers its area with a staggered grid of tiny round dots on near-black. Each dot brightens and dims on its own rhythm, and the brightest gain a soft blue halo, so the whole field shimmers.
use: A call-to-action or hero needs a quiet moving backdrop behind a card, cheap enough to leave running.
avoid: It is tuned for dark surfaces, and the loop never stops while on screen.
a11y: The decorative canvas carries no aria-hidden or role, and the endless shimmer ignores prefers-reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A near-black stage filled edge to edge with a fine grid of tiny round dots, offset row from row. Most dots sit dim grey with a few brighter ones scattered like faint stars, and a dark rounded card with a heading, paragraph and two buttons floats in the centre.
behaves: Each dot pulses between dim and bright on its own phase and speed, and the brightest briefly gain a soft blue glow. The field keeps shimmering in place indefinitely and never reacts to the pointer.
customise: Dot spacing and radius, dot and glow colours including theme variants, overall opacity and pulse speeds are props; there is no content to supply.
weight: moderate: Draws several thousand dots per frame, though it pauses once scrolled out of view.
